title: Meet local version history
summary: Version control records changes over time. Git can work on your own computer without a hosting service.
introduction: Version control records changes over time. Git can work on your own computer without a hosting service. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Version control records changes over time. Git can work on your own computer without a hosting service.

blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: Use Git in a new practice folder containing only your own sample files. These commands run in a local terminal, not this website. No online account is needed for these lessons.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of Git. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.
The command reports the installed Git version. If Git is missing, use its official installation guide with a trusted adult.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain the difference between saving a file and recording a version in Git.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Git and GitHub are different tools: local Git does not require a GitHub account.
For more detail later, use this [Git further reading](https://git-scm.com/docs/gittutorial).
